actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.TimeServices.delete#WeekEntry').parameters({timeEntryId: timeEntryId || ''}).call() || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {deleted: true, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.projects.TimeServices.start#Timer').parameters({workEffortId: workEffortId || '', comments: comments || null}).call() || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {timeEntryId: out.timeEntryId, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.work.TimesheetServices.stop#Timer').parameters({timeEntryId: timeEntryId || null}).call() || {} ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {stopped: true, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: out.message}]})

render-mode.text: ${JSON.stringify([{t: "dynamicContainer", id: "MyTimeTui", url: sri.buildUrl("//" + (appRoot === "People" ? "People" : "Projects") + "/Time/MyTimeTui").addParameters({partyId: partyId || null, weekDate: weekDate || null}).getUrlWithParams()}])}
${ec.l10n.localize('My time opens in the browser app (the qvue render mode).')}
